title: A response can remember
description: A teaching clock moves a cube while two physical gate models compare present proximity with a retained visit. FRAME, APPROACH / AWAY and RESET let the visitor separate the events.
limitation: Exact State browser-study transitions presented in 3D. Each FRAME adds a synthetic 0.5 seconds; it is not a measured engine frame. APPROACH is an explicit input, not player tracking. No museum gate is controlled.

title: One rule makes a family
description: One angular rule makes two straight columns. A fixed four-sided, two-metre reference stands beside editable height and radial count; the two-ring position list stays visible in the geometry.
limitation: Port of the Function browser study, not the museum's richer profile generator. Height 1–3 m in 0.1 m steps; radial counts 4, 6, 8, 12, 16. A declared 0.70 m display radius replaces browser pixels. Side faces and top cap only. Rendering duplicates corners for flat normals; the input list contains exactly 2*n positions.
